newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver spurts, gold awaits festival demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver spurts, gold awaits festival demand.

text.p: Silver prices opened higher on Thursday but demand resistance and emergence of profit-taking trimmed early gains towards the close, dealers said.

Gold opened higher but held steady at that level during the day, dealers said. Gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) settled 100 rupees higher at 59,700 rupees per piece. They were up by 150 rupees per piece on Wednesday.
Physical demand for the precious metals was low despite approaching festivals but traders were expecting better buying next week.
